facts.fact: The University of Leicester paper titled 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?' investigates the feasibility of Hiccup supplying fish to maintain Toothless's diet.
In the paper, it is stated that Toothless would have required 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon every day for 12 days, totaling 716 kg.
Hiccup would have needed to carry 828 fish weighing a total of 8592 kg over twelve days, which is deemed unrealistic.
The main author of the paper is Amal Doua from The Centre for Interdisciplinary Science, University of Leicester.
